articles.title: I vostri utenti non vogliono un chatbot
articles.excerpt: Se state per collegare un LLM a un'applicazione gestionale dietro un widget di chat, considerate prima un pulsante. Ecco perché è più facile da collaudare, autorizzare e verificare. Quando un'azienda…
articles.body: Se state per collegare un LLM a un'applicazione gestionale dietro un widget di chat, considerate prima un pulsante. Ecco perché è più facile da collaudare, autorizzare e verificare. Quando un'azienda decide di aggiungere l'intelligenza artificiale a un gestionale o a un portale clienti, la prima idea è quasi sempre la stessa: una chat nell'angolo dello schermo. In demo funziona benissimo. In produzione, nella maggior parte dei casi, è l'interfaccia più debole che si potesse scegliere. Gli utenti non vogliono conversare con il software: vogliono che il lavoro che fanno già richieda meno passaggi. Perché la chat regge male in produzione Perimetro illimitato. Un campo di testo libero non dice all'utente che cosa può fare. Chi non sa cosa chiedere chiede di tutto, oppure non usa la funzione.

articles.title: Audit a Virtual Staging Settings Log with Python
articles.excerpt: The same settings protocol at StagingBench used no custom prompt or mask in any of 119 runs across 12 tools. Eleven tools contributed 10 records apiece, and one contributed nine. Style was usually Mod…
articles.body: The same settings protocol at StagingBench used no custom prompt or mask in any of 119 runs across 12 tools. Eleven tools contributed 10 records apiece, and one contributed nine. Style was usually Modern or a variant. To audit that part of the protocol, count settings coverage and style coverage independently. A run can have settings marked as recorded while its style field is empty. Architecture drift measures how closely the staged image kept the original walls, windows, and doors. Lower values indicate closer preservation. The script uses three standard library modules. csv.DictReader reads each row into a dictionary keyed by the header. Keep the quotes around labels such as Bedroom, Modern because the comma is part of the name. Consecutive commas represent an empty style field.
articles.author: StagingBench Team

articles.title: tafqit: write money amounts in words, in Arabic and French, from Rust or Python
articles.excerpt: Every invoice, receipt and cheque ends with the same line: the total, written in words. In Algeria that line is often needed twice, once in Arabic and once in French. It looks like a small formatting…
articles.body: Every invoice, receipt and cheque ends with the same line: the total, written in words. In Algeria that line is often needed twice, once in Arabic and once in French. It looks like a small formatting job, until you try to write the code. Arabic number grammar is the hard part. The counted noun changes form depending on the number: دينار واحد , ديناران , ثلاثة دنانير , خمسة عشر دينارًا , مائة دينار . The number itself changes gender against the noun, and duals and tens change with grammatical case. French has its own traps: quatre-vingts but quatre-vingt-un , deux cents but deux cent un , mille that never takes an s . tafqit (تفقيط, the Arabic word for writing a number in letters) is a Rust library, a command-line tool and a set of Python bindings that do this job for both languages.
articles.author: Abdeldjalil Chougui

Here are the crypto security features we added after. on 18 November 2026 someone attacked Wealtii , my crypto investing platform, for nearly seven hours. They sent 8,255 requests, created 67 empty accounts, tried 125 withdrawals and stole $0. One week later I shipped a security release with 172 fixes . This post covers what changed, in before-and-after form, without any detail that would help the next attacker. I'm Zayd , the solo founder of Wealtii . This is the second attack I have written about this month. The first one, on 4 November, lasted 105 minutes. This one lasted from 03:33 to 10:18 UTC .

articles.title: Your users do not want a chatbot
articles.excerpt: If you are about to wire an LLM into a business app behind a chat widget, consider a button first. Here is why it is easier to test, authorize and audit. When a company decides to add AI to an ERP or…
articles.body: If you are about to wire an LLM into a business app behind a chat widget, consider a button first. Here is why it is easier to test, authorize and audit. When a company decides to add AI to an ERP or a customer portal, the first idea is almost always the same: a chat box in the corner of the screen. It demos beautifully. In production it is, in most cases, the weakest interface you could have picked. Users do not want to have a conversation with their software. They want the work they already do to take fewer steps. Why chat holds up badly in production Unbounded scope. A free text field does not tell users what they can do. People who do not know what to ask either ask anything or never use the feature.
articles.author: Omar Baruzzo

articles.title: Should you use a 301 or a 302 when you're not sure the new URL is permanent? Let's argue about it
articles.excerpt: Scheduled broken-link and redirect checks that tell you the moment a link breaks — linkbruno.com The documentation is clear if you take it at face value. 301 means "moved permanently". 302 means "foun…
articles.body: Scheduled broken-link and redirect checks that tell you the moment a link breaks — linkbruno.com The documentation is clear if you take it at face value. 301 means "moved permanently". 302 means "found it over there, for now". The trouble is the middle case, which is most of the real work: a campaign page that might be the permanent home, a rebrand you're "pretty sure" about, an A/B test URL, a documentation move you may have to revert after the new IA settles. Teams pick 302 to stay safe, then forget to change it. Or they pick 301, then spend a quarter undoing caches and search results. Both regret something. Let's argue about it. The case for 301, even if you're not 100% sure Clients and caches will do what you told them.
articles.author: linkbruno.com

articles.title: December full moon 2026: When, where and how to see the Cold Moon
articles.excerpt: Your guide to December's full Cold Moon, from peak times to skywatching highlights.
articles.body: The December full moon reaches peak illumination at 8:28 p.m. EST on Dec. 23 (0128 GMT on Dec. 24) as the lunar disk shines opposite the sun in Earth's sky. It is often called the "Cold Moon" in reference to the frigid temperatures that prevail in the Northern Hemisphere around the time of its rising, according to the Old Farmer's Almanac . December's full moon will also occur close to perigee — the moon's closest point to Earth in its elliptical orbit — giving rise to a spectacular supermoon. A supermoon can appear 30% brighter and 14% larger than a full moon at its farthest point from Earth (also known as a micromoon)..

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 25, 1970: NASA's 'wingless' M2-F3 'lifting body' aircraft makes its 1st powered flight ahead of supersonic tests
articles.excerpt: On Nov. 25, 1970, an experimental aircraft called the Northrop M2-F3 made its first powered flight. Here's why it mattered.
articles.body: On Nov. 25, 1970, an experimental aircraft called the Northrop M2-F3 made its first powered flight. The M2-F3 aircraft was a heavyweight "lifting body" designed to test its ability to produce most of its lift through its fuselage instead of wings. It's commonly referred to as a "wingless" aircraft. After Air Force test pilot Bill Dana took the M2-F3 on three unpowered glide test flights, he did the first powered flight, too. Dana soared to an altitude of 45,000 feet during this flight, which lasted just over 6 minutes. He didn't break the sound barrier this time, but he did on later flights. The M2-F3 flew a total of 27 missions in its three-year flight history. Its top speed was 1.6 times the speed of sound, and its top altitude was 71,500 feet.
